# Framont Access

> Framont Access is the investment product platform of Framont & Partners Management Ltd — a Malta-based management company licensed by the Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA) under the Investment Services Act (Cap. 370) and authorised as a UCITS management company and Alternative Investment Fund Manager (AIFM) under the AIFMD. The platform gives eligible investors curated access to institutional-grade investment products: investment funds, actively managed certificates (AMCs), exchange traded instruments (ETIs) and selected private market deals.

Key facts:

- Operator: Framont & Partners Management Ltd., Dragonara Business Centre, 5th Floor, Dragonara Road, San Ġiljan STJ 3141, Malta (VAT MT22666318)
- Corporate site: https://www.framontmanagement.com/
- Platform: https://access.framontmanagement.com/ (English and Italian)
- Access model: product details unlock with free registration; the Deals section is reserved for vetted investors
- Nothing on the site is investment advice or a public offer; products are intended for eligible investors and subject to jurisdiction restrictions

## Investment funds (reserved — professional and eligible investors)

Framont & Partners Management Ltd manages a focused range of alternative investment funds spanning Italian real estate, distressed credit and global capital-market strategies, described on the [Funds page](https://access.framontmanagement.com/#/funds):

- Gentile da Fabriano: closed-ended reserved Italian real estate AIF, long-dated horizon of up to 30 years
- Orizzonte: closed-ended reserved Italian real estate AIF, guided by a dedicated Real Estate Management Committee
- Wright: closed-ended reserved Italian real estate AIF focused on Rome, for professional investors or subscriptions from €500,000
- Real Sequoia: closed-ended reserved Italian real estate AIF, funds the construction, completion and development of the assets it holds
- Pinnacle Investment: closed-ended reserved Italian real estate AIF across residential, office, commercial, industrial and tourism assets in Italy, the EU and the G8
- Hubble Capital: closed-ended reserved Italian AIF, credit compartment — distressed credit largely secured by real estate collateral
- Asymetria Fund: open-ended absolute-return sub-fund of Global Series SICAV plc (Notified AIF, Malta) — equity-derivatives strategy, EUR, monthly dealing
- Earth Horizon Fund: private equity sub-fund of Global Series SICAV plc (Notified AIF, Malta) — EUR and USD share classes, semi-annual dealing
- CIREDCO Fund 1: closed-ended Notified AIF (Malta) — Coinvesting Italian Real Estate Distressed Credit Opportunities Fund, NPLs/UTPs secured by Italian property

Fund Rules (Regolamento di Gestione) or Offering Supplement and Offering Memorandum are available on request from the Management Company / AIFM.

## Listed products

- [HERAKLIT Strategy ETI](https://heraklit.framontmanagement.com/): exchange traded instrument, ISIN DE000AMC0D44, listed on Börse Stuttgart
- [Tech Megatrend Tactical ETI](https://techmegatrend.framontmanagement.com/): exchange traded instrument, ISIN DE000AMC0D85
- [Snow White — Value Edge ETI](https://access.framontmanagement.com/it/eti/value-edge-snowwhite/): exchange traded instrument issued by iMaps ETI AG and listed on Börse Stuttgart, EUR, issue price EUR 100, minimum €100 — Value Edge is the legal name of the segregated portfolio, SnowWhite the discretionary multi-market long/short strategy applied within it, developed by Giovanni Zibordi (up to 50 simultaneous positions across equities, index and bond futures, options, currencies and commodities, 2% stop per position, 300% mandate exposure cap) and managed by Framont & Partners Management Ltd. Newly issued instrument with no track record of its own; management fee 1.0% p.a., performance fee 25%, with the full cost disclosure in the PRIIPs KID, available from Framont on request. ISIN DE000AMC0BZ5
- IVN Global ETI: exchange traded instrument, ISIN DE000AMC0DX6, actively managed global long/short strategy across equities, currencies, commodities and digital assets
- [Erere Quant Income ETI](https://access.framontmanagement.com/it/eti/erere-quant-income/): open-end collateralised exchange traded instrument listed on Börse Stuttgart, issued through a dedicated iMaps Capital Markets segregated cell, EUR, issue price EUR 100, minimum €100 — systematic options-income strategy on US equities and ETFs across five proprietary components, cash secured and unleveraged, with a self-funded long-volatility tail hedge. Strategy promoted by Erere S.r.l. and traded by Domenico Dall'Olio, structured and managed by Framont & Partners Management Ltd. ISIN DE000AMC0EJ3. Published performance figures are backtested and out-of-sample results on simulated accounts, not live trading
- [Noctiluca Capital AMC](https://access.framontmanagement.com/it/amc/noctiluca-capital/): actively managed certificate for professional investors, ISIN CH1554882477, issued through a protected cell of Expand2 Issuer PCC Limited (Guernsey) on the GenTwo platform, EUR, EUR 1,000 per certificate, minimum 10 certificates, issued 29 June 2026, unlisted, private placement — a rules-based breakout and trend-following strategy on eight listed futures markets (three equity indices, two metals, two energy contracts and one currency contract; three more on hold, and the universe changes over time) with a 1% target risk per trade, subject to a one-contract minimum which can exceed 1% on low-contract markets, aggregate exposure capped at 200% and four exit rules, managed by Framont & Partners Management Ltd on software licensed from Kajero Ltd; management fee 2.00% p.a., performance fee 20% above the high-water mark. Track-record figures relate to 852 trades executed on test capital between March 2024 and May 2026; the certificate has no track record of its own. [Term sheet (PDF)](https://access.framontmanagement.com/assets/termsheets/framont-noctiluca-amc-termsheet.pdf)
- [Zalphyx Yield Strategies CLN](https://access.framontmanagement.com/it/amc/zalphyx-yield-strategies/): 6% p.a. USD credit-linked note for professional and qualified investors, ISIN CH1518693374, issued through a protected cell of Expand3 Issuer PCC Limited (Guernsey) on the GenTwo platform, USD 1,000 per note, minimum 10 notes, semi-annual coupon, issued 16 September 2026, maturity 24 September 2029, unlisted, private placement — linked to a private loan to Zalphyx Giant Capital LLC, which originates first-rank USD mortgage loans in the Dominican Republic with a maximum 50% loan-to-value; coupons and redemption depend on the loan being repaid. The initial subscription window closed on 9 September 2026 and the issue carries a reopening clause. [Term sheet (PDF)](https://access.framontmanagement.com/assets/termsheets/framont-zalphyx-cln-termsheet.pdf)

## Compare, structure and vocabulary

- [Product comparison](https://access.framontmanagement.com/compare/): every product open to subscription side by side — wrapper and structure, strategy, liquidity, currency, costs and eligibility, filtered by funds, AMCs and ETIs. Italian: [Confronto prodotti](https://access.framontmanagement.com/it/confronto/)
- [Structure and safeguards](https://access.framontmanagement.com/structure/): the regulated chain behind each wrapper — investor, venue, issuer, portfolio manager, post-trade agents — and the licences behind the platform. Italian: [Struttura e presidi](https://access.framontmanagement.com/it/struttura/)
- [Glossary](https://access.framontmanagement.com/glossary/): thirty-two plain-language definitions of the vocabulary used across the product pages — ETI, AMC, reserved and Notified AIF, AIFM, depositary, paying agent, management and performance fee, high-water mark, ongoing costs, backtest, investor classifications, KID, prospectus, Fund Rules, ISIN, issuer risk, private placement. Italian: [Glossario](https://access.framontmanagement.com/it/glossario/)

## Editorial standards

Articles are written by the Framont Access editorial team and reviewed for regulatory and structural accuracy by Gianluigi Montagner, CEO and Founder – Chief Executive Officer, Framont & Partners Management. Every material legal, numeric, licence, listing or product-structure claim is tied to a named primary source with a stated date, and claims that hold only in one jurisdiction or only for one Framont product are labelled as such on the page.
